protocol.copyright: Copyright 2026 The Sphatik OS Authors SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description.summary: request compositor-rendered glass behind surface regions

protocol.description: Lets a client ask the compositor to draw Sphatik glass (blur, refraction, tint, rim light) behind rounded rectangles of a surface. The client draws its own content on top with transparent pixels where the glass should show. The compositor may degrade or drop effects to meet its frame budget.

request.name: get_glass

description.summary: create a glass object for a surface

request.description: At most one sphatik_glass_v1 per wl_surface; a second request is a protocol error.

entry.name: already_has_glass
entry.summary: surface already has a glass object

interface.name: sphatik_glass_v1
interface.description: State is double-buffered and applied on the next wl_surface.commit.

description.summary: remove all glass from the surface

request.name: add_region

description.summary: add a rounded rectangle of glass

request.description: Coordinates are in surface-local logical pixels. Regions may not overlap; overlapping regions are merged by the compositor.

request.name: set_tint

description.summary: override the adaptive tint for all regions

request.description: Colour as premultiplied RGBA, 8 bits per channel packed into a uint. Zero restores the adaptive tint.

event.name: tier
event.description: Sent on creation and whenever the tier changes, so the client can adjust its own contrast.

entry.name: low
entry.summary: solid tint only (Reduce Transparency or budget exceeded)
